LanguageData.RC2_PlantCactusFruit.label: prickly pear cactus
LanguageData.RC2_PlantCactusFruit.description: A large-leafed desert cactus with edible fruit. Can only be grown in arid regions.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantGrapes.label: grapevine
LanguageData.RC2_PlantGrapes.description: Grape vines have been cultivated for eons and are the source of delicious grapes. Just be careful, they're a finicky plant that can only be grown in temperate regions - but not the more humid swamps.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantJuniper.label: juniper bush
LanguageData.RC2_PlantJuniper.description: Evergreen shrubs that grow in colder climates, Juniper bushes produce a special kind of berry that is used as a spice and in making Gin. Does best in colder climates.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPepper.label: chili pepper bush
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPepper.description: Chili pepper plants produce deliciously spicy chili peppers. Great for sauces and spicing up foods! Grows in subtropical and tropical regions.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPepperHydro.label: chili pepper bush

LanguageData.RC2_PlantPineapple.label: pineapple plant
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPineapple.description: Pineapple plants are a tropical plant that produces an edible and delicious fruit. This plant can only be grown in tropical regions.

LanguageData.RC2_PlantPineappleHydro.description: Pineapple plants are a tropical plant that produces an edible and delicious fruit. This plant can only be grown in tropical regions.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantQuinoa.label: quinoa plant
LanguageData.RC2_PlantQuinoa.description: A seed producing flowering plant native to mountainous regions. This particular cultivar prefers warm, wet climates and will only grow in tropical regions.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantSoybean.label: soybean plant
LanguageData.RC2_PlantSoybean.description: Soya bean plant grow legumes that are often used as a meat substitute for those too squeamish to eat the flesh of the dead. Grows in temperate and tropical regions.
